card.name: Small linking words before drug or condition
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as of, to, with, in and the adjective significant, in drug-label sentences where a specific drug name or condition is about to follow. Often seen in opioid overdose and antagonist wording.

modes.label: of before a named item
modes.description: The word of after a noun phrase, just before a drug or condition name.
modes.example: 5.7 Persistence or Reappearance<< of>> Bacteriuria Nitrofurant

modes.label: to/with/in linking phrases
modes.description: Linking words after an adjective or noun, leading into a drug or condition.
modes.example: If clinical signs and symptoms consistent<< with>> liver disease develop

modes.label: clinically significant
modes.description: The word significant after clinically, before a depression or effect term.
modes.example: For clinically<< significant>> respiratory or circulatory depression secondary to rem
